name: Band Clamshell
steps: Lie on one side on the floor with a resistance band looped just above your knees, hips and knees bent, and heels stacked together.
Brace your core lightly and keep your hips stacked vertically perpendicular to the floor.
Raise your top knee smoothly upward against the band while keeping your heels pressed together.
Lower your knee slowly back to the start without letting the band go slack, then switch sides after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your top hip from rolling backward as your knee opens.
Pause briefly at the top to maximize tension in your outer glute.
